mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate signals tighter monetary policy, leading to higher borrowing costs and reduced consumer and business spending, which negatively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of cases when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate indicates a strong labor market, which may lead to increased consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of cases when UNRATE decreases, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real consumer spending (RSAFS) suggests strong demand, which can drive corporate revenues and stock prices higher, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of cases when RSAFS increases by 1%, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates a strong supply chain and economic activity, which can lead to increased productivity and higher stock prices, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of cases when INDPRO increases, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 5% and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4%, it indicates a tight labor market and potential inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of cases when UNRATE < 5% and FEDFUNDS > 4%, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A slowdown in GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates reduced economic activity, which can lead to lower corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of cases when GDPC1 growth is below 2%, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) suggests strong demand in the housing market, which can lead to increased economic activity and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of cases when HOUST increases, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) is above 190 and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4.5%, it indicates high inflation and tight monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of cases when CPIAUCSL > 190 and FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, the hypothesis is rejected.
